messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated py/ts SDK release in ~20m (small patch: batching perf + TS types fix). Plan: run CI -> build artifacts -> publish npm @stable tag + upload wheels -> update dist-tags and publish release notes. Will pin old sync-client major under 'legacy-sync' dist-tag. Any objections? :eyes:

sam: sounds good. pin strategy ok for me — just confirm the package.json 'engines' bump doesn't break older installs.

miguel: agree with pin. +1 to keep a dedicated dist-tag for legacy callers. Also we should add a short deprecation blurb for sync client in the changelog so support can triage.

anya: will add changelog blurb. support-ops pinged to prep messaging. I'll run a local build now and trigger publish in 15.

deploy-bot: publish-job started for thread 1779991234
status: running -> building artifacts
logs:
```
> npm pack @redwood/sdk
> python -m build
> twine check dist/*
```

jen: quick question — do we want a shadow publish to internal registry first, or straight to npm/pypi?

liam: there's an edge case last release hit a checksum mismatch on pypi. recommend shadow to internal registry, validate checksums, then push public. saves rollbacks.

anya: good catch. switching to shadow first. will publish to internal (registry-internal.redwood) and verify artifacts. if checksums + smoke tests pass, we push public and flip dist-tag.

miguel: checklist for release (copying so ops can follow):
- build and sign artifacts (wheel, sdist, npm tgz)
- upload to internal registry + validate sha256
- run smoke tests (install from internal, basic generate/embeddings smoke)
- update changelog & release notes snippet (include deprecation note for sync client)
- flip dist-tag: remove 'latest' -> set 'stable' to new version, set 'legacy-sync' to previous major if not already
- announce in #general + support thread with upgrade notes

anya: running artifact build now — posting sha when ready.

deploy-bot: artifact build complete. wheel sha256: d4f7b9c8a2b0e6f3c9e5a1b6f7e9c3a1d2e4f6b8c9a0b1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f
npm tgz sha1: 8d7f1a9c3b

liam: Checking internal registry upload now. if checksum mismatch, we stop and republish signed wheel.

deploy-bot: upload to internal registry succeeded, installed from internal in smoke VM, basic generate + embeddings test passed.

sam: sweet. what's the rollback plan if we see errors after flipping dist-tags?

anya: rollback plan short: quick steps below — (1) add 'stable' back to previous version: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<previous> stable` and `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<previous> latest` if needed, `npm unpublish` only as last resort. For PyPI, re-upload previous wheel under the 'stable' name via our internal index or change our release pointer. Also revert docs PR and push emergency patch to customers via support.

miguel: also add route-level fallback in runtime: cloud config can route requests to the older model handler for 1h while we triage. ops already has the runbook.

anya: ok holding off public publish until internal smoke window ends (target +30m). I'll post final go/no-go here.

deploy-bot: smoke-window timer started (30m). will update on completion.

jen: thanks — I'll prepare release notes draft and short deprecation blurb for sync client send to product.

liam: one more note — add checksum and signature to release notes so customers can verify quick.

anya: noted. will include SHAs + signature. back in ~30. :coffee:
